title: Veal Scaloppine
description: Thin pan-fried veal with a creamy onion and mushroom sauce. Quick, simple, and deeply satisfying.

method.instruction: Pound veal escalopes until thin and even. Dust lightly with flour, shaking off excess.
Heat butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Pan-fry veal quickly for 1–2 minutes per side until golden. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
In the same pan, add a little more butter if needed. Soften onion until golden, about 3–4 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until golden and tender, about 3 minutes.
Pour in demi glace and thickened cream. Stir and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Season with salt. Plate the veal, pour the sauce over, and garnish with fresh parsley.

notes.title: Flour-Dusted Only
notes.content: The veal is lightly dusted with flour — not crumbed. This gives a delicate golden finish and helps the sauce cling, without the heaviness of a schnitzel coating.

notes.title: Demi Glace
notes.content: Demi glace is the backbone of this sauce. If using commercial base, prepare according to packet instructions before adding. A good quality beef stock reduction can substitute in a pinch.
